blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Being shirtless or half-naked in public places is now punishable in Daanbantayan town, Cebu. This came after the town passed an ordinance penalizing it. The measure aims to make communities safer — allowing people to freely go about their daily lives without fear of harm — by lowering crime rates and restoring public order. The move complies with the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG)’s Safer Cities initiative.
